title: Rethinking Supervision Scaling in On-Policy Distillation: From Dense Supervision to Stochastic Horizons
abstract: arXiv:2611.20687v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision along student-generated trajectories, yet the learning benefits of longer trajectories may not scale proportionally with their computational cost. We investigate how supervision utility evolves with trajectory length. Controlled experiments reveal diminishing returns from additional supervised tokens, while showing that later positions remain learnable and exhibit substantial cross-position supervision transfer. Gradient analysis further identifies shared update components across response positions and diverse position-specific residuals whose cross-rollout consistency decreases at greater depths. Motivated by these findings, we propose Stochastic Horizons On-Policy Distillation (SH-OPD), which reduces redundant supervision by randomly varying rollout horizons while preserving access to deeper response states. translated_title: 重新思考在线策略蒸馏中的监督扩展：从密集监督到随机视界
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）在学生模型生成的轨迹上提供密集的词元级监督，然而更长轨迹带来的学习收益可能无法与其计算成本成比例增长。我们研究了监督效用如何随轨迹长度的增加而演化。受控实验揭示出，额外的监督词元会带来收益递减，同时表明轨迹中较靠后的位置仍然是可学习的，并表现出显著的跨位置监督迁移。梯度分析进一步识别出跨响应位置的共享更新分量，以及多样化的位置特定残差，而这些残差的跨 rollout 一致性在轨迹更深处会有所下降。受这些发现启发，我们提出了随机视界在线策略蒸馏（SH-OPD），通过随机变化 rollout 视界来减少冗余监督，同时保持对更深层响应状态的可及性。SH-OPD 为每个训练批次采样一个共享的视界……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文发现在线策略蒸馏中沿长轨迹的密集监督存在收益递减但监督可跨位置迁移，据此提出随机视界在线策略蒸馏（SH-OPD），通过为每个训练批次随机采样 rollout 视界来减少冗余监督、降低计算成本，同时保留对深层响应状态的学习能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals diminishing returns from dense token-level supervision along long trajectories in on-policy distillation, and proposes Stochastic Horizons On-Policy Distillation (SH-OPD), which randomly samples a rollout horizon per training batch to reduce redundant supervision while preserving access to deeper response states.
